UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated AOS Tools user profile and role metadata.

displayName.description: User display name from Google profile.

role.description: User access tier within AOS Tools.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest login.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

UserSecurityConfig.title: UserSecurityConfig
UserSecurityConfig.description: Private per-user tool locking preferences, hashed PIN, and auto-lock settings.

ownerId.description: Owner UID matching Firebase Auth UID.

pinHash.description: SHA-256 salted hash of operator security PIN (empty string when disabled).

pinEnabled.description: Whether PIN protection is enabled for locked tools.

requireAuthForProTools.description: Whether high-tier tools require active Google authentication.

autoLockMinutes.description: Inactivity auto-lock duration in minutes (0 disables auto-lock).

lockedToolIds.description: Bounded list of tool IDs currently locked by the user.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest security config update.

LedgerEntry.title: LedgerEntry
LedgerEntry.description: Per-user Client Diary ticket and financial charge entry stored strictly under the owner's UID.

id.description: Unique ledger entry identifier matching document ID.

services.description: Services rendered for this client ticket.

governmentFees.description: Official portal challan/fee amount in INR.

status.description: Current fulfillment status of the ticket.

clientCreatedAt.description: Client creation epoch milliseconds for ordering.

LedgerSummary.title: LedgerSummary
LedgerSummary.description: Per-user Client Diary custom summary balance overrides.

todayWorkCharge.description: Optional override for today's work charge.

totalGovFeesAll.description: Optional override for total government fees disbursed.

monthWorkCharge.description: Optional override for monthly work charge.

pendingCount.description: Optional override for pending token count.

UserCloudBackup.title: UserCloudBackup
UserCloudBackup.description: Encrypted/structured user cloud backup storing preferences, notices, security preferences snapshot, and Client Diary backup under users/{uid}/cloudBackup.

backupVersion.description: Schema version for cloud backup snapshots.

securityPrefs.description: Lock preferences snapshot map (pinEnabled, requireAuthForProTools, autoLockMinutes, lockedToolIds).

notices.description: Bounded operator live status notices list (max 20).

ledgerCount.description: Total Client Diary entries count at backup time.

ledgerSnapshot.description: Bounded recent Client Diary records snapshot (max 100).

summaryOverrides.description: Client Diary custom summary overrides map.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest cloud backup.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores verified user profile records strictly accessible only to the profile owner or admins.

/users/{userId}/private/{configId}.description: Isolated private security preferences and tool lock configurations owned by the user.

/users/{userId}/ledger/{entryId}.description: Per-user Client Diary ledger entries tied strictly to the signed-in user's UID.

/users/{userId}/ledgerSummary/{summaryId.description: Per-user Client Diary financial summary balance overrides.

/users/{userId}/cloudBackup/{backupId}.description: Cross-device encrypted/structured cloud backup of AOS user preferences, lock preferences, live notices, and Client Diary records.
